snippet.title: SWAPMEAT Accolades Trailer | New Roguelite Out 2025
snippet.description:
See what players are saying (and asking) about SWAPMEAT, the juiciest new body-swappin' roguelite shooter coming to Steam later this year!

Mouth watering yet? The MEAT LAB 6 playtest opens July 17, so it's the perfect time to get a taste for yourself 🤤

🤘 PLAYTEST ACCESS: https://playswapmeat.com
🤘 WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790700/SWAPMEAT/
